title: Extension doc-set navigation tree (docs-tree.json)

audience.$comment: The docs.md audience split, closed: 'user' pages live under docs/user/ (or the set's user section), 'dev' pages under docs/dev/sdk/ (or the set's authoring section). No third audience exists.

chapterSlug.$comment: The plan-34 chapter taxonomy, closed and family-wide (guidelines/extension-docs.md is the law). 'chapters' is the conformance marker: optional, but when a set declares it, it declares exactly the ten — never missing chapters.

i18n.$comment: Nav-label i18n, SAME shape/conventions as the extension manifest's i18n block (locale pattern, 16 locales, 400 keys/values) — the family string rule: labels resolve through the host locale, never hardcoded per-render. Key naming is the set's choice; completeness beyond 'defaultLocale + locales' is wall/validator-owned per product (deliberately not schema-checked).

id.$comment: Stable and unique across the whole tree (uniqueness is wall-checked — JSON Schema cannot express it).

file.$comment: Path RELATIVE to the tree's own directory; never absolute. Existence is wall-checked, not schema-checkable.

then.$comment: A leaf node (no children) MUST reference its doc file; a grouping node may carry one as a section index.

project.$comment: The doc set's slug (product or SDK name), not necessarily the repo slug — e.g. 'career-connector-sdk'.

chapters.$comment: Chapter-conformance marker, optional but validated when present: exactly the ten taxonomy slugs (cross-tree node ids SHOULD mirror them — the wall checks declared chapters have matching node ids).

chapteredTree.$comment: The plan-34 form every SDK-grade doc set adopts (waves 2-6). The ten-chapter skeleton at templates/docs-set/ is the reference instance.

legacyCategoryList.$comment: The as-landed extension-tree form (health's builtin integrations since the pre-charter SDK; drives the in-app docs dialog). Accepted so real trees validate TODAY; new SDK-grade sets use chapteredTree. Wave 4 records whether each health tree migrates or stays (both validate).

$comment: STRUCTURAL GATE ONLY — the docs-tree contract of plan 34 / guidelines/extension-docs.md. Beyond structure, wall/validator-owned (deliberately NOT schema-checked): node-id uniqueness across a tree; every 'file' resolves to an existing .md next to the tree; declared 'chapters' have matching node ids; i18n key completeness when a product needs locale coverage; docs.md page rules (one H1, opening paragraph, relative links) which apply to every page a tree references. The PRODUCT-level docs/docs-tree.json of guidelines/docs.md (audiences -> categories -> items) is NOT this contract's scope — different file, different law, never mix the two shapes in one artifact.
